verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract lifecycle management SaaS product, not an AI agent client; there is no mention of MCP server integration in any evidence, and the product's own AI features are not framed as an agent capable of consuming external MCP tools. This axis applies to agent-type products or platforms with an MCP ecosystem story, but no such angle exists here — the evidence only covers REST/webhook APIs and OAuth for traditional integrations.
